_comment: The only hand-written part of this repo. Everything else is derived. Leave a value as null to fall back to whatever your GitHub account already says.
tagline: CS undergrad building production-grade AI systems, one commit at a time.
about: Final-stretch CS undergrad from Biratnagar, Nepal, preparing for campus placements.
Most of my time goes into full-stack AI products, data-structures practice, and shipping things that actually run in production rather than only in a notebook.
Open to SDE / ML internship and new-grad roles.
focus: Building **CareerLayer**, an AI resume analyser with a prompt-injection integrity layer
Deep Learning coursework, and DSA practice on a daily cadence
Getting better at system design and interview communication

projects.name: CareerLayer
projects.blurb: AI resume analyser and job-match platform. Dual extraction, evidence-grounded claims with bounding-box overlays, explainable match scoring, and a prompt-injection detection layer that flags resumes engineered to fool an LLM screener.

projects.name: Infrared Image Quality Classifier
projects.blurb: Classifies infrared imagery by quality, extended from single frames to video streams while keeping the original image pipeline intact.
